subject: MIMO solutions battery: multi-path replacements + H1 market-ML correction + depth kill + fail-closed ACI
body:
MIMO loop + SOLUTIONS battery (user: multiple paths, not one). Worktree stats/books-ordering-2026-09-18.

KILLS / MEASUREMENTS (commands run, numbers observed)
- K3 band still KILLED OOT 0.7705 < 0.85. Replacement PROMOTED: weather/roof Mondrian 6/6 OOT>=0.85 + rest_diff buckets (H5). Product: No-band on K3 residuals.
- H1 CORRECTION: first-pass Elo vs Phi(-spread/sig) was ARTIFACT (spread-map Brier ~0.347). Honest market = moneyline p Brier 0.211 n=5051. As-of Elo 0.233 LOSES (delta_market_ml_minus_elo = -0.022). Kill line NOT met — Elo/adj-EPA stay research shadow.
- H3 realised information bits on export settled: marketFairProb +0.075 (n=741 Brier 0.225) ONLY positive; confidence/100 -0.081; rankingP -0.021; independentTrueProb -0.016. Public/rank p = marketFairProb when priced. Confidence = Edge Index display only.
- H8 frozen ML scorecard baseline: market ML Brier 0.211 (n=5051, seasons on disk). Engine ML claims require Brier <= 0.209 n>=272 as-of.
- H2 CLV ladder Law-10: pooled R1 graded 0.229 / decided 0.231 / BEAT|LOST 0.406 / MATCHED win 0.479. TOTAL R4 0.567 EXCLUDES MATCHED — do not claim engine CLV skill. I5: MLB TOTAL R4 0.598 n=366 named cell only.
- I1 DEPTH KILL: bookmakerCount Spearman vs bin hit -0.80 pooled (-0.60 MLB SPREAD) vs marketFairProb +0.90 → DEPTH_DISPLAY_ONLY. Never rank on book count.
- I3 coach 4th&short go-rate sticky 2023-2025 (coach Spearman 0.473/0.383 mean 0.428 >= 0.20) → CANDIDATE factor, NOT wired. Wire only if holdout Brier improves >=0.002 n>=272.
- I4 Shin vs proportional de-vig NFL ML n=5050: ΔBrier ~2e-5 << 0.002 → PROPORTIONAL_STAYS.
- H6 CLV association only: SPREAD info slope +1.93 (se 0.42); TOTAL -1.67; never labeled public/sharp money.
- Totals e-process M_max 4.43-10.3 < 20 → no skill claim. ML logit FIRE_NOTHING. Hex32 0.9775 resolve (retry path live).
- PASS veto: export script emits independentEdge*/passVeto (board-export.mjs:161-167); DISK export STALE (export_has_edge_fields=false). Ops re-export then census. Product: never mint PASS/expectedClv<0.

REPLACEMENTS SHIPPED (not deletions)
- packages/prediction-engine tweedie-aci.ts + conformal-margin-set.ts: fail-closed +Inf when k=ceil((n+1)p)>n; warmup empty residuals = point band status warmup_point_band (not coverage claim). Tests 15/15 PASS on signal-arch-typecheck.
- apps/web/lib/calibration/compute.ts: additive computeMarketAnchoredDualScore (marketFairProb/independentTrueProb vs confidence/100 on same settled rows + exclusion count). No gate flip. No MODEL_VERSION.
- docs/ops/stats-lane solutions_battery.py (S1-S7) + solutions_battery_v2.py (H1-H8 corrected) + side_agreement/adaptive_delta/coach_stickiness/shin/clv_dual instruments + SOLUTIONS_BATTERY_MASTER.md + loop_implement_replacements.py.

KILL LINES STILL ACTIVE
K3 No-band · weather UQ promoted while OOT holds · ML withheld vs market Brier 0.211 · Elo ranking authority only if Brier<=market_ml-0.002 n>=272 · coach CANDIDATE until holdout · never mint PASS · no CLV admission · no skill language until e-process M_max>=20 · Law 10 every rate.
